reuse.why: It routes all providers through the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked check, but re-writes unlinkAccount's field-clearing updateAccount instead of extracting a shared 'clear link fields' helper that unlinkAccount and the takeover both use.

duplication.why: The eight-field updateAccount block clearing account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: A function named and used as a guard (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked) now performs the unlink mutation, mixing validation with a side effect that runs before the new link is created.

scope.why: Only the link parameter threading, the guard and one test are changed.

maintainability.why: Threading a boolean through six provider functions into a guard that silently mutates, plus a second copy of the unlink field list that must stay in sync with unlinkAccount, makes this harder to own than a named helper would.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked: clears the other account with its own db.updateAccount instead of going through the unlink logic of unlinkAccount (or a helper extracted from it)

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink field reset is an undisguised verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's updateAccount call
